mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS shop_count, COUNT(m.id) AS member_count, COALESCE(SUM(m.balance), 0) AS total_balance FROM shop s LEFT JOIN member m ON m.shop_id = s.id AND m.is_deleted = 0 WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.is_deleted = 0

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(b.total_amount), 0) FROM bill b INNER JOIN shop s ON s.id = b.shop_id AND s.is_deleted = 0 WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND b.type = 'CONSUME' AND b.is_cancelled = 0 AND b.is_deleted = 0 AND b.created_time >= #{since}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shop s WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.is_deleted = 0

SELECT s.id, s.name, s.logo, s.address, s.phone, s.open_time, s.close_time, s.weekly_off, s.created_time, COUNT(m.id) AS member_count, COALESCE(SUM(m.balance), 0) AS total_balance FROM shop s LEFT JOIN member m ON m.shop_id = s.id AND m.is_deleted = 0 WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY s.id ORDER BY s.created_time DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
